cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed the official Georgian e-Visa portal (evisa.gov.ge/GeoVisa) and consular portal (geoconsul.gov.ge) both exist and both list 'PHOTO' as a required upload for a Georgian visa application, but neither page's fetched content specifies size, background color, or composition rules. A Ministry of Foreign Affairs D3 (study visa) requirements PDF (mfa.gov.ge/pfiles/files/D3-study-visa-requirements.pdf) was also read directly and only says 'One biometric photo' is required, with no technical spec. Georgia's Ministry of Justice Order No. 98, which does specify a 3.5x4.5cm biometric photo size (see ge-passport.json), governs registration/ID/passport/travel-document issuance for citizens and residents — it is a different legal instrument from the visa process for foreign nationals entering Georgia, so its figure was NOT carried over to this file without independent confirmation for visas specifically. Widely-repeated third-party claims that Georgia e-visa photos must be 472x591px (4x5cm) or use a 'light grey' background could not be traced to any accessible official Georgian government page and are excluded.
cross_verification.note_ko: 조지아 공식 전자비자 포털(evisa.gov.ge)과 영사포털(geoconsul.gov.ge) 모두 사진 업로드를 요구한다는 사실은 확인했으나, 실제 페이지 본문에는 크기·배경색 등 세부 규격이 명시되어 있지 않았다. 외교부 D3(유학) 비자 PDF도 직접 열람했지만 '생체인식 사진 1매' 요구만 있을 뿐 규격은 없었다. 여권 규정(법무부령 98호, 3.5×4.5cm)은 자국민/거주외국인 대상 별도 법령으로, 외국인 대상 비자 절차에 그대로 적용된다고 확인되지 않아 이관하지 않았다.
